bundle.shortDescription: Identify the group of a bird from what you see, ranked by probability
bundle.longDescription: Version 1: a faithful rebuild of Birds Group Identification (with Prob): choose characters of a sitting or flying bird (size, crown, eye, beak, neck, body, wings, tail, legs, feet) and see the 222 bird groups ranked by probability, with pictures.
